analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has entered oversold territory, but MACD histogram continues to worsen, extending the downtrend. ADX at 20.2 indicates an early stage of trend formation, with direction yet to be confirmed. The 5-day low of 204,500 is equal to the 20-day low of 204,500, failing to form a Higher Low pattern. The price is near the lower Bollinger Band, but low trading volume reduces confidence.
